chart_specs.description: Agreement statistics across independent labeler runs on the same stratified sample.
chart_specs.title: Inter-labeler agreement on the reference label set

description: Label a stratified sample of work items with independent labelers to build a reference label set, and report inter-labeler agreement on it.
hypothesis: Independent labeler runs on the same sampled items agree well enough (nominal Krippendorff's alpha above chance) that the adjudicated labels are a reference the v3 quality scores can be evaluated against.

legend.cohens_kappa: chance-corrected agreement between a pair of labelers
legend.dispatchable_rate: fraction of labelled items whose dispatchable label is yes
legend.krippendorff_alpha: nominal Krippendorff's alpha over the label matrix, missing labels included
legend.labeler-a: first independent labeler run on the sampled items
legend.labeler-b: second independent labeler run on the sampled items
legend.labeler-c: third independent labeler run on the sampled items
legend.live_environment: access to a running system, host, or cloud account
legend.no: the item needs a decision or an external action before work can start
legend.operator_or_other_team: a human operator, another team, or another repository must act or decide
legend.percent_agreement: fraction of items on which every labeler who answered gave the same label
legend.repo_only: changes and checks inside the repository: code, tests, docs, CI
legend.yes: a fresh worker could complete the item from its text alone
